locale.unsaved.zh-CN: 本次界面语言尚未可靠保存；当前稿和原操作未改变。
locale.unsaved.en-US: The interface language has not been durably saved. Your draft and original operation are unchanged.

locale.unavailable.zh-CN: 界面语言偏好暂不可读取，使用默认语言；当前稿和原操作未改变。
locale.unavailable.en-US: The interface language preference is unavailable. Using the default language; your draft and original operation are unchanged.

desktop.unsavedClose.zh-CN: 恢复稿尚未确认持久保存，窗口保持打开。
desktop.unsavedClose.en-US: The recovery draft is not confirmed durable. The window remains open.

desktop.waitingForInput.zh-CN: 正在等待输入完成和草稿保存。
desktop.waitingForInput.en-US: Waiting for input to finish and the draft to be saved.

desktop.startupDisabled.zh-CN: 系统已禁用登录启动；Weftext 不会自行恢复此设置。
desktop.startupDisabled.en-US: The system has disabled login startup. Weftext will not re-enable it automatically.

capture.pending.zh-CN: 原操作结果尚未确认；恢复稿和原编号已保留。
capture.pending.en-US: The original operation is unconfirmed. Its draft and original ID are retained.

reminder.enabledDevice.en-US: Enable this reminder on this device

reminder.submitted.zh-CN: 系统已接受提醒；不代表用户已读。
reminder.submitted.en-US: The system accepted the reminder. This does not mean it was read.

reminder.unknown.zh-CN: 系统提交结果未知，未盲目重发。
reminder.unknown.en-US: The system submission result is unknown. It was not blindly resubmitted.

reminder.unavailable.zh-CN: 当前条件不允许提交系统通知。
reminder.unavailable.en-US: System notifications cannot be submitted under the current conditions.

reminder.missed.zh-CN: 有 {count} 项有效的错过提醒。

error.resourceRead.en-US: The resource could not be read.

cli.description.zh-CN: 正式命令行：读取、写作、查询、交换与同步。
cli.description.en-US: Command-line access for reading, writing, querying, interchange and synchronization.

cli.requestRetained.zh-CN: 准确原请求已保留在 {path}；原操作：{operationId}。
cli.requestRetained.en-US: The exact original request is retained at {path}; original operation: {operationId}.

cli.partial.zh-CN: 仅所述范围已完成，其余范围未计为成功。
cli.partial.en-US: Only the reported scope is complete. Other scope is not counted as successful.

cli.unknown.zh-CN: 原操作 {operationId} 的效果尚未确认；请求保留在 {path}，仅按原编号查询。
cli.unknown.en-US: The effect of original operation {operationId} is unconfirmed. Its request is retained at {path}; inspect the original ID.

cli.error.en-US: The command did not complete. Code: {code}.

cli.deliveryFailed.zh-CN: 本机交付未完成；原操作 {operationId} 与请求文件 {path} 已保留，不重复提交业务效果。
cli.deliveryFailed.en-US: Local delivery is incomplete. Original operation {operationId} and request file {path} are retained; the business effect is not resubmitted.

cli.requestFileRequired.zh-CN: 此命令可能产生持久或外部效果，须指定新的 request-file；首次发送前保存准确输入，不包含凭据。
cli.requestFileRequired.en-US: This command can have a persistent or external effect. Provide a new request-file to retain the exact input before its first submission, without credentials.

cli.invalidInput.zh-CN: 输入不完整、格式或 UTF-8 无效，或超出预算；未发送请求。
cli.invalidInput.en-US: Input is incomplete, has invalid format or UTF-8, or exceeds its budget. No request was sent.

cli.invalidEndpoint.zh-CN: 远端须明确使用不含用户信息、查询参数或片段的 HTTPS origin；不接受跨 origin 重定向。
cli.invalidEndpoint.en-US: A remote endpoint requires an explicit HTTPS origin without user information, query or fragment. Cross-origin redirects are rejected.

cli.credentialsRequired.zh-CN: 远端凭据从受保护文件或明确的环境变量读取；不接受包含密钥的命令行参数。
cli.credentialsRequired.en-US: Read remote credentials from a protected file or an explicit environment variable. Secret command-line arguments are not accepted.

cli.requestConflict.zh-CN: 原请求定位器或内容不一致，未重新发送。
cli.requestConflict.en-US: The original request locator or content differs. It was not resubmitted.

cli.unsupported.zh-CN: 当前执行端或命令未提供此能力。
cli.unsupported.en-US: This endpoint or command does not provide this capability.

cli.outputExists.zh-CN: 输出路径 {path} 已存在，拒绝覆盖原件。
cli.outputExists.en-US: Output path {path} already exists. The original is not overwritten.

cli.helpCommands.zh-CN: 使用 --help 查看命令；使用 <命令> --help 查看该命令的参数。
cli.helpCommands.en-US: Use --help to list commands, or <command> --help for that command's arguments.
